findings.summary: Delivery exceeds the spec's literal three-file boundary ('恰好三个文件,其余零改动'): the rework also adds a read-only decision_list tool to the engine plus 3 accompanying tests (exactly accounting for the make-verify delta 2966→2969, so no other files changed). The extension is the remediation path the prior continuous review (rc-63632f2e, REJECT blocker) prescribed for the mechanically unsatisfiable 01/02/10-PASS criterion, and the dispatcher's re-dispatch kept the fenced acceptance asserting pass010=3 — i.e. selected the engine-tool path; the frozen R0 probe contract (tests/test_r0_verify_rebuild.py:478, byte-identical to base 99103be) already required the decision face to expose decision_list, so verify-rebuild 01–21 judgment logic is untouched and the engine change is additive, pure-read, and covered by purity tests. The spec text was never amended (digest unchanged at f15363c4…): dispatcher/merger should record the boundary amendment in the merge note so the document and the tree stop disagreeing.
